info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-Delete Payments Payments Void-v2-spec
info.description: The Void Payments API allows businesses to cancel or void payment transactions before they are completed. This endpoint is primarily used to manage payment processing by providing a mechanism to reverse a transaction, ensuring that customers are not charged incorrectly. Typical consumers of this API include financial systems, e-commerce platforms, and billing services that require the ability to manage and rectify payment issues efficiently. Developers can integrate this functionality into their applications to maintain accurate financial records and enhance customer service.

delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a payment that has previously been voided. Use this endpoint to ensure that the payment no longer appears in your records.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to void a payment. It should contain the necessary information to identify the payment that needs to be voided.

200.description: The void operation was successfully completed.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidRequest.description: This schema represents the request body format for voiding payments via a DELETE operation.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.title: Void Payment Response

status.description: Indicates whether the void operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the payment.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the void operation.

state.description: The current state of the payment after the void operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the void operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the void operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit trail of the void operation.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.description: Response schema for a successful payment void operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the void operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the void operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the void operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema describing the audit information for the payment void operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.
